scope: Exact archived iPad Simulator application and its Saved annotations sheet. The initial EPUB and saved highlights are synthetic. Physical Pencil, VoiceOver, and iPadOS 17 remain open.

test_details.unique_and_unplaced: The sheet showed exactly two warning rows beneath their appropriate saved quotes. The uniquely resolved quote had no unplaced warning.
test_details.original_context: All three rows named Chapter 1 as the original chapter. From Chapter 2, the ambiguous row reopened Chapter 1 without rewriting its saved anchor.
test_details.recovery: A fresh process reopened Chapter 1, reconstructed both warnings, and left all annotation records, notebook records, and source edition data unchanged.
test_details.earlier_harness_result: A launch argument pinned the original width. The acceptance rerun used the normal writable Simulator app preferences and restored them afterward.
